summary: Linde plc filed an 8-K to report the issuance of three tranches of unsecured notes under its European debt issuance programme: €600M Floating Rate Notes due 2028, €500M 3.200% Notes due 2030, and €500M 3.800% Notes due 2036. The notes were sold via a subscription agreement with managers; net proceeds of ~€1,595M will fund general corporate purposes. This is a plain-vanilla debt offering with no special-situation event—no change of control, shareholder action, or restructuring. Routine capital markets activity.
